   Add a README.md to cc-capture-scratch

   Context

   The repository at /private/tmp/cc-capture-scratch has no README and no existing documentation. It currently contains only
   scratch material: a tracked note.txt ("hello"), an untracked sorted.txt ("hello"), an empty out/ directory, and an untracked
   launch.sh symlink pointing to a script outside the repo. There is no remote, no build/test config, and no code beyond these two
   one-word text files.

   Since the repo has no evident project purpose, the README will document what is actually verifiable — the workspace as it
   stands — rather than invent a purpose, usage, or tooling that doesn't exist. (Assumption made because the clarifying question
   was declined; if you'd rather the README center on the launch.sh / launcher-script workflow, or be a fill-in-the-blanks
   template, say so and I'll adjust.)

   Approach

   Create a single file, README.md, at the repo root. Short (~15–25 lines), factual, no fabricated sections.
